criteria.description: Validate shipped static GLB, official format validation, scale/origin, exact geometry/texture budgets and provenance.

Inspect every final exact view and compare to original scope. Actual concept hero/front/end/top inspected. Preserve narrow layered wall and upper causative tube. Reduce large backing wall which obscures rear laminae, preserve full basal slab. Model shallow gutter-shaped ribbons as solid connected stack with real relief but no large open gaps, and no coplanar visible tube/lamina overlay.

Verify One straight narrow wall-like raised trace relief composed of closely packed vertically stacked curved gutter-shaped sediment laminae. A simple horizontal causative burrow follows the upper edge; front/rear face displays lamina stack and end view reveals shallow gutter cross section. Solid irregular basal sediment slab and full-volume laminae; not separate floating pipes, a giant U-shaped burrow, shell, branching network or identified animal. Stylized Teichichnus morphology based on KGS2002 T.rectus KUMIP288500, figure57 top relief and cross-section. Raised relief and exposed wall sectional convention illustrative, not exact specimen replica. Geometry follows retrusive vertically/subvertically stacked gutter-shaped laminae, while counts, colors and block dimensions are artistic. Trace names morphology not producer; behavior and depositional setting are not rendered as established facts.
Verify the frozen brief, complete deliverables and all explicit constraints.
Parse this exact GLB with the pinned target loader and record bounds, materials and errors.
Render this exact GLB in the target graphics runtime; inspect frames and capture renderer/device and measured work.
Render the intended composed scene including this exact GLB; inspect scale/contact/material consistency and measure scene work.
